tagline.en: A trunk road almost entirely in tunnel, built to cross central Kowloon from Yau Ma Tei to Tseung Kwan O
tagline.zh: 一条几乎全在隧道里的干线，自油麻地横穿中九龙直达将军澳

start.en: The Yau Ma Tei interchange in West Kowloon, where it joins the West Kowloon Highway (Route 3)
start.zh: 西九龙油麻地互通立交，与西九龙公路（3号干线）相接

end.en: The Tseung Kwan O interchange of the Cross Bay Link, out on the water of Junk Bay — the only trunk-route end in Hong Kong that is entirely at sea
end.zh: 将军澳跨湾连接路的将军澳互通立交，位于将军澳海面之上——全港唯一完全设于海上的干线端点

en: Route 6 is the third trunk road across Kowloon, after Route 5 along the shore and Route 7 along the hills, and it goes under the city rather than through it. From the Yau Ma Tei interchange on the West Kowloon Highway it runs east beneath Yau Ma Tei, King's Park, Ho Man Tin and To Kwa Wan to the Kai Tak development, then under Kowloon Bay to Cha Kwo Ling and through the hill to Tseung Kwan O. Planned at about 11.9 km, it is open in the air only at the Cha Kwo Ling interchange and in the Kai Tak area.

Because it is nearly all tunnel, and tunnels are not designated expressways in Hong Kong, the whole route will have no expressway section when it is complete. It meets Route 3 at Yau Ma Tei, Route 5 at Kai Tak and Route 2 at the Kowloon end of the Eastern Harbour Crossing, and it gave Tseung Kwan O a second road tunnel to the city.

It is not finished. Two of its three pieces were open by the end of 2025 — the Tseung Kwan O–Lam Tin Tunnel and the Yau Ma Tei section of the Central Kowloon Bypass, about 8.5 km together. The middle piece, the Kowloon Bay section under the bay, is still being built.
zh: 6号干线是继沿海岸的5号干线和沿山坡的7号干线之后，第三条横贯九龙的干线，而且是从城市底下穿过，而不是从中间穿过。它由西九龙公路的油麻地互通立交起，向东在油麻地、京士柏、何文田、土瓜湾地底穿行至启德发展区，再在九龙湾海底通往茶果岭，然后穿山抵达将军澳。规划全长约 11.9 公里，只有茶果岭互通立交和启德一带是露天路段。
由于几乎全是隧道，而香港的行车隧道不列为快速公路，全线建成后将没有任何快速公路路段。它在油麻地与3号干线相接，在启德与5号干线相接，在东区海底隧道九龙出入口与2号干线相接，也让将军澳有了第二条通往市区的行车隧道。
它还没有建完。到 2025 年底，三段之中已有两段通车——将军澳—蓝田隧道和中九龙绕道油麻地段，合计约 8.5 公里。中间一段，即在九龙湾海底的九龙湾段，仍在施工。

en: The Yau Ma Tei section, built as the Central Kowloon Route, is a 4.7 km dual three-lane road of which about 3.9 km is tunnel. Most of the land tunnel was driven by drill-and-blast, more than 2,400 blasts in all. Under Queen Elizabeth Hospital blasting was limited to 15-minute windows so as not to disturb the hospital's equipment, and under Nathan Road the road tunnel passes as little as 3 metres from the MTR's.

At its eastern end a 370 m tunnel crosses under the water between Ma Tau Kok and Kai Tak. It was built inside a temporary reclamation of about 3 hectares, and the seabed was restored afterwards. The western portal needed the demolition of the Yau Ma Tei car park building, a public library, the Jade Hawker Bazaar and the specialist clinic extension.

The Kowloon Bay section, built as Trunk Road T2 and the Cha Kwo Ling Tunnel, is about 3 km long, 2.7 km of it under the sea, with two lanes each way. A 2004 review of Kai Tak planned on a no-reclamation basis replaced the reclaimed road first drawn for T2 with a tunnel, and the method later changed from immersed tube to tunnel-boring machines.

The Tseung Kwan O–Lam Tin Tunnel is a 3.8 km dual two-lane road, 2.2 km of it in a tunnel under the hill east of Cha Kwo Ling. A coastal alignment with reclamation was dropped after 2010 in favour of a straight tunnel with no toll-plaza island, which cut the reclamation and, by the department's estimate, HK$1.7 billion from the cost.
zh: 油麻地段的工程名称为中九龙干线，全长 4.7 公里，双程三线，其中约 3.9 公里为隧道。陆地隧道大部分以钻爆法开挖，共爆破逾 2,400 次。在伊利沙伯医院地底，爆破限于 15 分钟的时段内进行，以免影响医院仪器；在弥敦道地底，行车隧道与港铁隧道最近处相距仅 3 米。
油麻地段东端有一条长 370 米、连接马头角与启德的海底隧道，在约 3 公顷的临时填海范围内建造，完工后海床已复原。西面出入口则需拆卸油麻地停车场大厦、一间公共图书馆、玉器市场及专科诊所新翼。
九龙湾段的工程名称为 T2 主干路及茶果岭隧道，长约 3 公里，其中 2.7 公里在海底，双程双线。2004 年以「不填海」为原则的《启德规划检讨》，把原先需要填海的 T2 改为隧道；建造方法其后又由沉管改为隧道钻挖机。
将军澳—蓝田隧道全长 3.8 公里，双程双线，其中 2.2 公里为穿越茶果岭以东山体的隧道。原有连填海的海岸定线，2010 年后改为不设收费广场人工岛的直线隧道，减少了填海，按土木工程拓展署估算亦省下 17 亿港元工程费。

en: By the late 1990s the government expected the roads across Kowloon — Route 5, Boundary Street, Argyle Street, Prince Edward Road and Route 7 — to be close to saturation. A new east–west trunk road through central Kowloon first appeared in the 1998 outline zoning plans for Kai Tak North and Kai Tak South. The Central Kowloon Route itself had been studied since the Airport Core Programme; in 1998 it was proposed as a dual two-lane tunnel, revised in 2002 to dual three lanes, and a connection was left for it when the West Kowloon Highway's Yau Ma Tei interchange was built.

Consultation ran from 2007 to 2009 and again from December 2012. The Legislative Council's Finance Committee approved the main works on 20 October 2017 and construction began that December. The Yau Ma Tei section opened on 21 December 2025; the Highways Department expects it to cut the peak-hour drive from Yau Ma Tei to Kowloon Bay from about 30 minutes to 5.

The eastern end came first. Tseung Kwan O had grown from under 200,000 people when the Tseung Kwan O Tunnel opened in 1990 to nearly 500,000 in the 2010s, and the old tunnel was regularly full. A second link was planned from 2005, gazetted in 2013 and authorised in May 2014; work began on 9 December 2016, the last blast went off in June 2020, and after delays put down to COVID-19 the Tseung Kwan O–Lam Tin Tunnel opened with the Cross Bay Link on 11 December 2022.

Trunk Road T2 was first proposed in a 1999 study of south-east Kowloon. Its main contract was awarded to Bouygues Travaux Publics in November 2019, and in April 2025 the government decided that T2 and the Central Kowloon Route would together be called the Central Kowloon Bypass, as its Kowloon Bay and Yau Ma Tei sections.
zh: 1990 年代末，政府预计横跨九龙的5号干线、界限街、亚皆老街、太子道及7号干线等主要道路即将饱和。一条穿过中九龙的东西向新干线，首次出现在 1998 年的启德（北部）及启德（南部）分区计划大纲草图中。中九龙干线本身自机场核心计划起已在研究：1998 年提出双程双线隧道方案，2002 年改为双程三线，兴建西九龙公路时亦已在油麻地互通立交为它预留接驳位。
公众咨询于 2007 至 2009 年及 2012 年 12 月起两度进行。2017 年 10 月 20 日，立法会财务委员会批准主体工程拨款，同年 12 月动工。油麻地段于 2025 年 12 月 21 日通车；路政署预计繁忙时间由油麻地至九龙湾的车程可由约 30 分钟缩短至 5 分钟。

东端反而最先建成。将军澳隧道 1990 年通车时，将军澳人口不足 20 万，到 2010 年代已近 50 万，旧隧道经常饱和。第二条通道自 2005 年开始规划，2013 年刊宪，2014 年 5 月获授权兴建，2016 年 12 月 9 日动工，2020 年 6 月完成最后一次爆破；其后因 2019 冠状病毒病疫情延误，将军澳—蓝田隧道最终与将军澳跨湾连接路于 2022 年 12 月 11 日一同通车。
T2 主干路最早见于 1999 年展开的东南九龙发展可行性研究。其主合约于 2019 年 11 月批予布依格土木（Bouygues Travaux Publics）。2025 年 4 月，政府决定 T2 主干路与中九龙干线通车后合称中九龙绕道，分别为九龙湾段和油麻地段。

en: Route 6 is a government road throughout: both tunnels were built with public money and are owned by the government, not franchised. The Central Kowloon Route alone, 4.7 km of road, is budgeted at HK$42.36 billion.

The Tseung Kwan O–Lam Tin Tunnel opened toll-free — the 2019 Policy Address dropped the planned HK$3 charge — and on the same day the old Tseung Kwan O Tunnel was made free as well. The Yau Ma Tei section is also free until the whole bypass opens; in July 2025 the government proposed a toll of HK$8 after that.
zh: 6号干线全线都是政府道路：两段隧道均由政府投资兴建并拥有，没有采用专营权模式。单是长 4.7 公里的中九龙干线，预算就达 423.6 亿港元。
将军澳—蓝田隧道通车时不收费——2019 年施政报告取消了原定的 3 元收费——同日旧的将军澳隧道亦改为免费。中九龙绕道油麻地段在全段通车前同样免费；政府于 2025 年 7 月建议全段通车后收费 8 元。

en: Until the Kowloon Bay section opens, the two open pieces do not connect: the Yau Ma Tei section ends at Kai Tak, and the Tseung Kwan O–Lam Tin Tunnel starts at Cha Kwo Ling. Between Yau Ma Tei and Kai Tak there are no intermediate exits. The Tseung Kwan O–Lam Tin Tunnel is limited to 80 km/h, and on its opening day the Cha Kwo Ling roundabout at its western end jammed.
zh: 九龙湾段通车前，已通车的两段并不相连：油麻地段止于启德，将军澳—蓝田隧道则由茶果岭开始。油麻地至启德之间没有中途出口。将军澳—蓝田隧道限速每小时 80 公里；通车首日，其西端的茶果岭环岛即已出现挤塞。

why.en: There is no single figure for the route: it is three projects, budgeted separately, and the last is unfinished. The sourced costs of each are given below.
why.zh: 全线没有单一造价：它由三个分别拨款的工程组成，最后一段尚未完工。各段有来源的造价列于下方。

label.en: Central Kowloon Route (Yau Ma Tei section)

value.zh: 预算工程费 423.6 亿港元

figures.source: Highways Department, Central Kowloon Route Project (project page)

label.en: Trunk Road T2 and Cha Kwo Ling Tunnel (Kowloon Bay section)
label.zh: T2 主干路及茶果岭隧道（九龙湾段）

value.en: Main contract HK$10.918 billion, awarded November 2019. In 2018 the whole project was put at about HK$16 billion. Both figures are from Chinese Wikipedia and have not been checked against CEDD.
value.zh: 主合约 109.18 亿港元，2019 年 11 月批出；2018 年整项工程预计约 160 亿港元。两项数字均出自中文维基百科，未与土木工程拓展署资料核对。

value.en: Estimated at HK$15.1 billion in total; the main tunnel contract, awarded in July 2016, was about HK$8.73 billion. Not checked against CEDD's final account.
value.zh: 预计总造价 151 亿港元；2016 年 7 月批出的主隧道合约约 87.3 亿港元。未与土木工程拓展署的最终结算核对。

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 将军澳—蓝田隧道

value.en: The Hong Kong SAR government, from public works funds voted by the Legislative Council; the tunnels are government-owned and run by a management contractor, not a franchise.
value.zh: 香港特别行政区政府，由立法会批准的工务拨款支付；隧道归政府所有，由管理承办商营运，而非专营权模式。

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 中九龙绕道 and 将军澳—蓝田隧道 (兴建模式：政府投资兴建)

value.en: About 11.9 km planned, of which 8.5 km open in 2025
value.zh: 规划约 11.9 公里，2025 年已通车 8.5 公里

timeline.en: A central Kowloon trunk road first appears in the Kai Tak outline zoning plans; the Central Kowloon Route is proposed as a dual two-lane tunnel.
timeline.zh: 中九龙干线首次出现在启德分区计划大纲草图中，并以双程双线隧道方案提出。

timeline.en: The Central Kowloon Route is revised to a dual three-lane tunnel.
timeline.zh: 中九龙干线改为双程三线隧道方案。

timeline.en: The Tseung Kwan O–Lam Tin Tunnel is authorised in May.
timeline.zh: 5 月，将军澳—蓝田隧道获授权兴建。

timeline.en: Work on the Tseung Kwan O–Lam Tin Tunnel begins on 9 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 9 日，将军澳—蓝田隧道动工。

timeline.en: The Finance Committee approves the Central Kowloon Route on 20 October; work starts in December.
timeline.zh: 10 月 20 日，立法会财务委员会批准中九龙干线拨款；12 月动工。

timeline.en: The Trunk Road T2 main contract goes to Bouygues Travaux Publics in November.
timeline.zh: 11 月，T2 主干路主合约批予布依格土木。

timeline.en: The Tseung Kwan O–Lam Tin Tunnel and Cross Bay Link open on 11 December, toll-free; the Tseung Kwan O Tunnel becomes free the same day.
timeline.zh: 12 月 11 日，将军澳—蓝田隧道及将军澳跨湾连接路免费通车；将军澳隧道同日取消收费。

timeline.en: The Yau Ma Tei section of the Central Kowloon Bypass opens on 21 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 21 日，中九龙绕道油麻地段通车。
